fields.label: Freshman Criteria
fields.description: For students who have completed 0-11 transferable college credits post high school

fields.label: 12-23 Credit Transfer Criteria
fields.description: For students who have completed 12-23 transferable college credits post high school

fields.label: 24+ Credit Transfer Criteria
fields.description: Students who have completed 24 or more transferable college credits post high school.
The 24+ Credit section has a primary and secondary criteria. To qualify, students can meet either the primary or secondary criteria. They do not need to meet both.
